name: AR-01
label: Safe R

key_factors: Incumbent Rick Crawford running with a large cash advantage ($1.0M vs $12K)
No polling or expert ratings; fundamentals dominate
model.rationale: Crawford holds a heavily Republican northeast Arkansas seat, is renominated, and outpaces Terri Green by roughly 15-to-1 in cash, while markets give Democrats almost no chance. The fundamentals point to a comfortable double-digit Republican win with little evidence to move it.
model.watch: Any unexpected polling showing Green within single digits, or a major outside-spending surge against Crawford, would warrant revisiting.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Rick Crawford seeks another term in this deeply Republican northeast Arkansas district, where the partisan lean favors Republicans by more than 20 points. He enters the general election renominated, with about $1.0 million on hand, while Democrat Terri Green has raised little and ends with under $13,000. A Libertarian candidate also appears on the ballot. No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, and prediction markets give Crawford roughly a 98 percent chance of winning.

The forecast rests on district fundamentals, incumbency, and the lopsided financial picture, all pointing to a decisive Crawford victory. A Democratic upset would require a dramatic, unforeseen shift in the district's basic partisan makeup.
